audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 2 and 3 were given to Quinn while whys[1] and whys[2] say Kennen threatens the stun and owns the wave; Level 6 was 'Skill' and first item was Quinn while whys[4] calls 6 'your spike' and whys[5] 'your peak window'.
audit.why: 52.05% over 171 games: Kennen owns everything from level 2 through first item and loses only the two-item stage, when Quinn becomes a full ranged carry. The packet chart matches row for row.
audit.corrected: L1 Skill, L2 Kennen, L3 Kennen, Levels 4-5 Skill, L6 Kennen, first item Kennen, 2+ items Quinn.

audit.why: Spike placement is right: Kennen at 2-3, 6 and first item, Quinn past two items. Behind Enemy Lines is a 3s roam ult with no combat power, so Quinn's spikes are item-driven while Kennen's are Slicing Maelstrom on a flat 120s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page attributes the blind to Vault (E) in four places — 'it knocks you back and blinds you', 'through the E vault and blind', 'Vault you away with E (the knockback + blind)', and the label 'Vault (Dash/Blind)'. The blind is Blinding Assault (Q). Vault is a dash that slows and briefly interrupts, with no blind. The text also claims you out-poke her at max Q range while her Q reaches 1025 to your 950.
audit.why: Riot text: Q Blinding Assault, 1025 range, 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s, marks and hinders vision; E Vault, 675 range, 12/11/10/9/8s, dash that damages, slows and briefly interrupts before she lands at max attack range; W Heightened Senses, 50/45/40/35/30s, attack and move speed plus a reveal.
audit.corrected: Vault is the 12s dash-away and interrupt; the blind is her Q, which also out-ranges your shuriken by 75 units — so poking is not automatically safe and the ability you all-in around is Vault.

audit.whatIsWrong: Vault is named as the cooldown to track everywhere but never given a number.
audit.why: 12/11/10/9/8s is short enough that the window is real but narrow, and it is the difference between an all-in landing and being knocked out of your own mark chain.
audit.corrected: Vault at 12s rank 1 written into the tracking lines.

edits.before: Quinn's E vault is the whole problem here — it knocks you back and blinds you right when you E-in to start a mark chain, so don't burn Lightning Rush onto her unless her E is down. Sit at max Q range and chip; one Thundering Shuriken plus your Electrical Surge on-hit autos out-trades her Harrier pokes because your magic damage doesn't care about her kite. At 2-3 you can punish her hard: if she steps up to last-hit in melee, a Q plus W stacks two marks and the stun threat alone forces her off the wave.
edits.after: Vault (E, 12s at rank 1) is the whole problem — it knocks her clear and interrupts you right when you E-in to start a mark chain, so don't burn Lightning Rush unless it is down. Her Q blinds and reaches 1025 to your 950, so trade when it is spent, not on cooldown. One Thundering Shuriken plus Electrical Surge autos still out-trades her Harrier poke. At 2-3 punish her: if she steps up to last-hit, a Q plus W stacks two marks and the stun threat alone forces her off the wave.

edits.before: Catch her with E-into-R at 6 so the storm stun-locks her through the E vault and blind
edits.after: Catch her with E-into-R at 6 so the storm keeps ticking after Vault peels her off

edits.before: Vault you away with E (the knockback + blind) the instant you E-in to start your mark chain
edits.after: Vault away the instant you E-in, then blind your autos with Blinding Assault (Q, 1025)

edits.before: Quinn wastes Vault (Dash/Blind) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Quinn wastes Vault (12s at rank 1) — commit the full pattern now.

edits.before: Track Quinn's Vault (Dash/Blind): Her self-peel. All-in when it’s down. When it is down — Stun-stack + R her.
edits.after: Track Quinn's Vault (12s at rank 1): her self-peel dash — the blind is her Q. When it is down — stun-stack + R her.

notes: Vault's 'briefly interrupting it' is a real interrupt in Riot's text, but whether it can cancel anything in Kennen's kit is not answerable from the data — Slicing Maelstrom is described as a summoned storm, not a channel — so no claim was made that she can interrupt your ult. Two further 'Vault (Dash/Blind)' labels remain in breakdown.trading and report[3]; they sit inside long composite strings whose rewrite would have pushed the length band for no added information, so only the two standalone occurrences were corrected.
